strings.name: Aaron Levie
strings.summary: Aaron Levie is an American entrepreneur who co-founded Box with partners in 2005, developing a file-storage project into an enterprise content management platform. He steered the company toward organizational customers, emphasizing collaboration, security and governance, and led it to a public listing. More recently, he has promoted generative AI for enterprise content and workflows. These products are team achievements; announcements and previews do not mean every feature is generally available.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026; selected education, entrepreneurship and product milestones. The 2026 activity is supported by a post-event recap; previewed features are not treated as generally available.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Box and promoted enterprise cloud content management, advancing organizational file collaboration, security and digital workflows.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended the University of Southern California from 2003 to 2005; left to build the business without earning a degree there.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Enterprise content cloud
strings.highlights.h1.text: Co-founded Box with partners and, from 2007, concentrated on enterprise file management, sharing and collaboration.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Content and artificial intelligence
strings.highlights.h2.text: Encouraged the Box team to apply generative AI to enterprise content; Box AI was announced in 2023, followed by expanded workflow capabilities.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Participates in the BoxWorks enterprise AI presentation
strings.timeline.t1.text: A post-event recap records him and the team introducing Box Context Retrieval and previewing Box Architect, discussing content governance and AI workflows.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Company announces Box AI
strings.timeline.t2.text: Discusses generative AI and enterprise content in the product announcement; the announcement invited private-beta registrations rather than announcing general availability.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Ends term as board chair
strings.timeline.t3.text: Concludes the chairmanship begun in December 2013; this is distinct from leaving the CEO or director role.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Box lists on the New York Stock Exchange
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company he co-founded begins public trading under BOX, entering a new phase as a listed company.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes board chair
strings.timeline.t5.text: Adds the chairmanship to his CEO and director roles, serving as chair until May 2021.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Focuses on enterprise customers
strings.timeline.t6.text: Shifts the company toward the enterprise market, developing products for secure cloud information management and collaboration.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founds Box
strings.timeline.t7.text: Co-founds the company with partners and becomes CEO and a director; leaves university that year to focus on the business.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Enters the University of Southern California
strings.timeline.t8.text: Begins university studies, later turning a file-sharing idea developed during college into a business.
